_calibration: Behavioural fixture for references/fixtures.md Fixture 4 (road-to-rewrites-that-keep-their-facts 3.1). The deterministic asserts pin facts the input holds (status, negation, hedge, unit-bound number word) and a number it does not; the rubric covers attribution, which a substring check cannot. The same before/after pair is graded offline by detect_ai_tells --baseline.

scenarios.prompt:
Humanize this paragraph. Return only the rewritten paragraph.

It is worth noting that our team is excited to share a pivotal update! The new export pipeline is still a draft proposal, and we did not migrate the legacy reports. It may cut report times for three customers in the pilot.

assertions.criterion: Keeps every fact of the input: the pipeline is still a draft proposal, the legacy reports were not migrated, the effect is hedged ('may') and limited to three customers in the pilot, and the work stays attributed to the team (we / our team), not to a single 'I'. Adds no number, date or achievement the input does not hold.
